title: The missing library book
text:
Characters: AMIR, LUCY, MRS LIM (the school librarian)

(A classroom at lunchtime. AMIR is on his knees, looking under the desks. LUCY walks in with her lunchbox.)

LUCY: Amir, what are you doing down there?
AMIR: (worried) I can't find my library book. It has to go back today!
LUCY: What does it look like?
AMIR: It's big and yellow, with a whale on the front. It's called Secrets of the Ocean.
LUCY: Did you have it this morning?
AMIR: (thinking hard) Yes! I read it in quiet reading time. Then we had art.
LUCY: Art! We were painting at the big table by the window.

(LUCY hurries to the window. She lifts up a pile of painting paper.)

LUCY: (holding up a yellow book) Is this it?
AMIR: (jumping up) Yes! You found it! Thank you, Lucy!

(MRS LIM comes in, carrying a box of books.)

MRS LIM: Hello, you two. Amir, is that my whale book?
AMIR: Yes, Mrs Lim. I nearly lost it, but Lucy found it just in time.
MRS LIM: (smiling) Well done, Lucy. And Amir, next time please keep your library book in your bag.
AMIR: I will, Mrs Lim. I promise.
